sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach are in excellent form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 games and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could be significant for the title race, with Stafford just two points behind leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in strong form, host Eccleshall in a match between two mid-table challengers. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a clash between sides separated by just one point in the table. Bilston Town, currently sixth, host Foley Meir at home. Barnton welcome Shawbury United in a fixture between two sides with contrasting form. Market Drayton Town face New Mills away, both teams struggling in the lower half. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with the visitors pointless after seven games. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's poorest performers. Crewe host Allscott Heath at home in a clash between struggling sides. Eccleshall host AFC Bridgnorth in their Saturday fixture.
